participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Served the fish and kept the girl in the house.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Named the short loaf and asked after the letter.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You sat the threepence board, said you were not in Fair Em, and left the afternoon to the desk.
